summary: Management screen to mark who attended an event. Shared Compose UI on **Android, desktop, web, and iOS**, backed by `:server` SQLite.
overview:
The Event Attendance screen is opened from an event detail. Editors with the right Firebase role can toggle attendance per member. The same Composable in `:app:shared` `commonMain` is hosted by each thin app module.

Goals:
- List members expected at the event.
- Toggle attendance with optimistic UI.
- Show loading, empty, and error states shared across clients.
shared_ui_policy: Prefer `commonMain` in `:app:shared`. Thin app modules only host the screen. `iosMain` / `androidMain` only if Firebase actuals need a change.
out_of_scope:
- Public Astro site does not show attendance.
- No new event CRUD in this feature.

auth.client: Firebase ID token on all attendance routes
auth.server: Verify token; require editor or admin role; no passwords stored

components.name: AttendanceDto
components.usage: JSON body for list and toggle.
components.notes: Align with `attendance` table: eventId, memberId, present, updatedAt.

components.name: AttendanceRepository
components.usage: Ktor Client calls for list and toggle.

components.name: AttendanceRow
components.usage: Each member row: name, role chip, checkbox.
components.notes: New shared row; reuse design-system checkbox.

components.name: AttendanceEmptyState
components.usage: Shown when the event has no members.

structure:
The screen is a `Column` inside `AttendanceScaffold`:

1. **Top bar** — event title and date (read-only).
2. **Member list** — `weight(1f)` `LazyColumn` of `AttendanceRow`.

Same layout on Android, desktop, web, and iOS.

sections.title: Top bar
sections.description: Scaffold top bar with the event name and ISO date. Back navigates to event detail.
sections.behavior: No edit actions. Loading uses a linear indicator under the bar.

sections.title: Member list
sections.description: A `LazyColumn` of `AttendanceRow`: display name, optional role chip, trailing checkbox bound to `present`.
sections.behavior: Checkbox toggles attendance (optimistic). Row tap does nothing else. Empty list shows `AttendanceEmptyState`. Error banner with retry.

endpoints.name: List attendance
endpoints.notes: Called on screen load; drives the list.

endpoints.name: Toggle attendance
endpoints.notes: Body `{ "present": true }`. Optimistic UI on the client.

persistence: Source of truth is the `attendance` table in **SQLite** on `:server` (SQLDelight). Clients do not cache locally; they hold ViewModel state for the session and refetch on retry.

tasks.title: Add AttendanceDto in :core
tasks.spec: Add `@Serializable` `AttendanceDto` and toggle request type in `:core` `commonMain`, aligned with the `attendance` table (eventId, memberId, present, updatedAt ISO 8601).
acceptance_criteria: Field names match the JSON the server will emit

tasks.title: Server routes for list and toggle
tasks.spec: Add Ktor GET/PUT under `/api/events/{id}/attendance` using existing SQLDelight `attendance` queries. Require Firebase editor/admin. Return `:core` DTOs.
acceptance_criteria: GET returns the member list with present flags
PUT updates one row and returns the updated DTO

tasks.title: Shared repository
tasks.spec: Add `AttendanceRepository` in `:app:shared` `commonMain` using Ktor Client + `:core` types. No dependency on `:server`.
acceptance_criteria: list(eventId) maps JSON to AttendanceDto list

tasks.title: ViewModel and shared screen
tasks.spec: Add `AttendanceViewModel` and `AttendanceScreen` in `commonMain`: scaffold, list, empty/error, optimistic checkbox. Register navigation + Koin. Thin app modules should already host shared UI — no per-platform screen copies.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to the attendance route shows the list
Toggle updates UI immediately and reverts on error
